name: Physeerlia
description: Native Overseerr and Jellyseerr requests and discovery integration [Development Channel].
overview: Seamlessly integrates Overseerr and Jellyseerr requests, discovery, and media management directly into the Jellyfin web client with automatic zero-login SSO delegation [Development Channel: desktop background isolation and rapid optimizations].

versions.changelog: Development Build v1.0.9.0: Eliminate lingering topbar underline when navigating back to Jellyfin; isolate and deactivate underlying Jellyfin DOM while Seer is active to achieve identical 60 FPS performance on desktop whether navigating from Jellyfin or directly loading Seer.

Fix topbar transparency/ghosting across themes and ensure header bar is never overlapped with positive top clearance; eliminate mobile rapid scrolling lag and gray artifacting by removing content-visibility: auto (which caused unpainted tile gaps), eliminating React setState churn on poster reveals via zero-state CSS opacity transitions, disabling backdrop-filter blur on mobile badges/controls, and keeping low-res placeholders mounted during progressive loads.

Fix background poster resizing on modal open/close; eliminate mobile gray flashing/tile dropping during poster clicks and advanced options transitions; remove heavy multi-card GPU blur and MutationObserver thrashing for smooth 60 FPS performance on mobile and PC.
Fix topbar transparency/ghosting across all Jellyfin themes; adjust Seer header bar positioning so title, logo, user badge, and sign out are never covered by the topbar.
Fix Seer scrollbar; preserve Jellyfin backdrop without delayed pop-in; fix library poster white flash/reload; add progressive low-res to full-res poster loading in Seer.
Add plugin logo (shown in Jellyfin plugin catalog/dashboard) and README screenshots.
Fix startup crash caused by stale-folder cleanup deleting newer plugin folder; cleanup now only removes strictly older versions.
Fix non-working scrollbar on Seer page; steadier dark backdrop and softer fade when switching between detail and request forms.
Automate startup auto-cleanup of stale sibling version directories to prevent Jellyfin assembly duplication and route conflicts.
Restore frosted glass UI on request & detail forms; eliminate mobile blue tap highlight; introduce unified modal backdrop for seamless zero-flash form transitions.
Fix modern MUI topbar tab bleeding; eliminate mobile modal layout glitching and GPU compositor tile crashes via portal rendering and observer decoupling.
Fix Abyss theme topbar bleed-through and lingering library tabs; resolve mobile GPU tile stutter, gray flashing boxes, and modal loading layout jumps.
Clean stable rollback release with deterministic packaging and verified integrity.
Roll back web interface to stable state prior to topbar/modal experimental adjustments.
Fix mobile modal flashing and GPU compositor tile glitches, eliminate nested backdrop blur artifacts, and ensure clean topbar styling without previous page bleed-through.
Fix background opacity to eliminate previous page bleed-through, clean topbar tabs, and ensure button parity.
